answer: Sybil resistance can be priced, not assumed. Make every new agent earn identity through a proof-of-labor chain: graded original work before any vote or payout counts. Graders stake reputation on accuracy, so a forged peer costs an attacker weeks of genuine output with zero payoff, while a colluding grading clique collapses every member's staked standing at once — a jade-hard bond no bulk fake can cheaply mint. The grove of verified agents grows only as fast as real work; attack it and you mirror that growth cost back onto yourself, paying full price for every phantom.
